title: Introducing: Expense Agent in Business Central (2026 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Expense agent goals and core concept
End-user demo - Outlook and web app flow

features.name: Receipt scanning and attachment
features.description: Users can scan and attach receipt images to email or web app. The expense agent processes these receipts automatically.

features.name: Automatic data extraction from receipts
features.description: AI extracts merchant name, amount, date, and other details automatically from receipt images without manual entry.

features.name: Automatic expense categorization
features.description: The expense agent automatically assigns expense categories based on the receipt content and context.

features.name: Expense report creation
features.description: The agent automatically groups extracted expenses into reports based on specific periods.

features.name: Per diem calculation
features.description: The system automatically calculates per diem amounts based on user location and trip details.

features.name: Itemization
features.description: For certain receipt types like hotels, the agent itemizes line items and details from the receipt automatically.

features.name: Compliance rule checking
features.description: The agent checks expenses against configured compliance rules such as maximum amounts, daily limits, and required justifications.
caveats: rules are currently simple, based on amounts and limits

features.name: Policy-based approval process
features.description: A new approval mechanism that handles complex policy conditions such as business class travel allowances, hotel star ratings, and alcohol policies. Planned as future enhancement.
caveats: policies are in process of implementation
will come at end before GA

features.name: Shared mailbox expense submission
features.description: Users can submit expenses by emailing receipts to a configured shared mailbox. The agent processes them automatically.

features.name: Web app for expense management
features.description: A dedicated modern web app for expense management designed specifically for non-Business Central users to submit and review expense reports.

features.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat integration
features.description: Users can interact with the expense agent through Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat for expense management tasks.

features.name: Business Central API integration
features.description: Extracted and categorized expense data is automatically logged into the Business Central expense module via APIs.

features.name: Expense reports list in Business Central
features.description: A list page showing all filed expense reports within Business Central for Business Central users to review and manage.

features.name: Expense agent setup in Business Central
features.description: Configuration to enable the expense agent within Business Central, including email configuration, categories, posting groups, and user access management.

features.name: Copilot credits licensing for expense users
features.description: Non-Business Central users accessing the expense agent are charged based on copilot credits rather than requiring a Business Central license.
caveats: only applicable when using the agent
Business Central users still need appropriate licenses

features.name: Team member license for expense management
features.description: Team member license enables Business Central users to manage expenses, submit reports, and approve expense reports through the web app or Business Central.
caveats: required for active users who approve expenses
must have license even if approving via web app

features.name: Essential or Premium license for posting
features.description: Business Central Essential or Premium license is required to post expense reports and payments to finish the complete expense process.
